title: Table
description: Rows of records with typed columns, including status pills. Shows at most 50 rows.
x-use-when: The user needs to see individual records or exact values: open tickets, top deals, overdue invoices, a list of accounts.
x-dont-use-when: The point is a comparison or trend (use bar_chart) or a single total (use kpi). Don't dump raw data: aggregate or pick the top N.
x-checks: Error when a row uses a key that isn't a column key.
Error when a cell's value doesn't match its column's format.
Error when a status cell isn't {"text": ..., "level": ...}.
Error when two columns share a key, or total_count is smaller than the number of rows.
Warns when there are 50 rows and no total_count (the user can't tell if the list was cut off).
Warns when percent values look like whole numbers (45 instead of 0.45).

columns.description: Columns in display order. Put the identifying column (name, ticket) first.

key.description: Lowercase key used in each row, e.g. "customer".

label.description: Column header in sentence case, e.g. "Days open".

format.description: Cell type. Numbers are right-aligned. date expects "YYYY-MM-DD". status expects {"text": "Overdue", "level": "critical"}.

rows.description: Row objects keyed by column key, already sorted in the order to display. A missing key or null shows a dash. An empty array shows empty_message.

total_count.description: Total matching records before the top-N cut. When larger than the row count, the table shows "Showing 25 of 1,840 rows".

empty_message.description: Shown when rows is empty, e.g. "No open tickets older than 30 days."
